Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item says PDB while the procedure only filters TEMP_PDB without defining complete scope, and criteria jump from 2 to 21. DeepSeek further invents a title sensor and omits complete evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive PDB objective is reviewable once the topology/spec/scope and criteria are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2018 Wistron-BMC-01038-V002: define whether `TEMP_PDB` is the complete PDB sensor scope or only its thermal subset; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 21 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–20 are missing, and provide the full PDB/PSU/feed/rail/channel IB/OOB/Web acceptance map.

review_improvement: Separates thermal filtering from full PDB coverage, adds electrical-domain traceability and exposes the eighteen-number criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PDB can expose thermal, voltage, current, power-good and fault information across multiple rails and feeds. The source filter selects only TEMP_PDB, so it cannot establish complete PDB coverage without an owner scope statement. Board revision and load affect ranges and scaling. Full passive inventories are safe, but criteria 3–20 and the electrical map cannot be guessed.
